31285.a:
- **systemd** — dastur (daemon), PID 1. Boot'da birinchi ishga tushadi, servislarni boshlaydi, kuzatadi, qayta ishga tushiradi, cgroup'ga joylaydi. Komponentlari: `systemd-journald` (log), `systemd-logind`, `systemd-resolved`, `systemd-networkd`, `systemd-timesyncd`, `systemd-udevd`.
- **systemctl** — systemd bilan gaplashadigan **client** (D-Bus orqali). O'zi hech narsani ishga tushirmaydi — systemd'ga "start qil" deydi.
- **journalctl** — journald binary loglarini o'qish.

Analogiya: systemd = server, systemctl = uning `kubectl`'i.

```
systemctl status nginx      # holat + oxirgi log qatorlari
systemctl start|stop|restart|reload nginx
systemctl enable --now nginx
journalctl -u nginx -f
ps -p 1 -o comm=            # PID 1 kim? -> systemd
```
Eski usul: `service nginx start` (SysV wrapper) — hozir ichida systemctl'ni chaqiradi.

31286.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `start` — servisni **hozir** ishga tushiradi, lekin reboot'dan keyin o'zi chiqmaydi. `enable` — servisni **boot'da** avtomatik ishga tushadigan qiladi, lekin hozir ishga tushirmaydi. `enable --now` — ikkalasini birdan qiladi.

**Muammo:** Ko'p junior'lar `systemctl start nginx` qiladi, hammasi ishlaydi — keyin server reboot bo'ladi va sayt ochilmaydi, chunki servis enable qilinmagan edi.

| Buyruq | Hozir | Reboot'dan keyin |
|---|---|---|
| `start` | ishlaydi | yo'q |
| `enable` | o'zgarmaydi | ishga tushadi |
| `enable --now` | ishlaydi | ishga tushadi |
| `stop` | to'xtaydi | enable bo'lsa yana chiqadi |
| `disable --now` | to'xtaydi | chiqmaydi |
| `mask` | start qilib bo'lmaydi | chiqmaydi |

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
   v  systemctl enable nginx
/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/nginx.service -> /usr/lib/systemd/system/nginx.service
   v  boot: multi-user.target "wants" papkasidagi hammasini ishga tushiradi
mask: /etc/systemd/system/nginx.service -> /dev/null  (hech kim start qila olmaydi)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo systemctl enable --now nginx
systemctl is-enabled nginx     # enabled / disabled / masked / static
systemctl is-active nginx      # active / inactive / failed
systemctl is-failed nginx
sudo systemctl mask --now telnet.socket   # qat'iy o'chirish
systemctl list-unit-files --state=enabled
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `static` holatdagi unit'da `[Install]` yo'q — uni enable qilib bo'lmaydi, boshqa unit tortadi.
- `disable` boshqa servis `Wants=` orqali tortganda baribir ishga tushishi mumkin — to'liq bloklash uchun `mask`.
- Unit faylni o'zgartirgach `daemon-reload` qilinmasa eski konfiguratsiya ishlaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Xavfsizlik hardening'da keraksiz servislarni `mask` qilish `disable` dan ishonchliroq. Provisioning skriptlarida doim `enable --now` — "reboot'dan keyin ishlamadi" sinfidagi incident'larni yo'qotadi.

31287.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `restart` = stop + start: jarayon o'ladi va yangisi chiqadi (PID o'zgaradi, aktiv ulanishlar uziladi). `reload` = unit'dagi `ExecReload=` ni bajaradi — odatda servisga signal (SIGHUP) yuborib, config'ni **to'xtamasdan** qayta o'qitadi. `reload-or-restart` — reload qo'llab-quvvatlansa reload, aks holda restart.

**Qanday ishlaydi (nginx misolida):**
```
restart:  master PID 100 o'ladi -> ulanishlar uziladi -> yangi master PID 200
reload:   kill -HUP 100 -> master config'ni o'qiydi
           -> yangi worker'lar ishga tushadi
           -> eski worker'lar joriy so'rovlarni tugatib chiqadi
           -> downtime yo'q, PID 100 o'zgarmaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx     # AVVAL sintaksis tekshiruvi
systemctl show nginx -p ExecReload               # reload nima qiladi
sudo systemctl reload-or-restart myapp
sudo systemctl try-restart myapp                 # faqat ishlab turgan bo'lsa
systemctl show nginx -p MainPID                  # reload'dan keyin o'zgarmagan
```
Unit'da reload'ni qo'llash:
```ini
[Service]
ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Xato config bilan `restart` — servis umuman ko'tarilmaydi (downtime). `reload` da nginx xato config'ni rad etib eskisi bilan ishlashda davom etadi — lekin buni ham `-t` bilan tekshirish kerak.
- Hamma servis reload'ni qo'llamaydi — `ExecReload` yo'q bo'lsa xato beradi.
- `systemctl reload app` va `systemctl daemon-reload` — butunlay boshqa narsalar (biri ilova config'i, biri unit fayllar).

**Senior nuqta:** Config o'zgarishi pipeline'ida: validate (`nginx -t`, `haproxy -c`, `sshd -t`) -> reload -> health check -> xato bo'lsa eski config'ga rollback. Bu tartib "bitta noto'g'ri qavs butun saytni o'chirdi" incidentlarining oldini oladi.

31288.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `daemon-reload` — systemd'ga barcha **unit fayllarni** diskdan qayta o'qishni buyuradi. Unit faylni (`.service`, `.timer`, drop-in) tahrirlaganingizdan keyin kerak — aks holda systemd xotiradagi eski versiyani ishlatadi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
/etc/systemd/system/app.service  (diskda yangi: MemoryMax=2G)
            |
            |  systemd xotirasi: hali eski (MemoryMax=1G)
            v
systemctl daemon-reload  -> xotira yangilandi
systemctl restart app    -> jarayon yangi sozlama bilan ishga tushdi
```
Ogohlantirish: `Warning: The unit file, source configuration file or drop-ins of app.service changed on disk. Run 'systemctl daemon-reload' to reload units.`

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo vim /etc/systemd/system/app.service
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart app
systemctl show app -p MemoryMax       # qiymat haqiqatan qo'llanganmi
# Qulayroq: drop-in yaratadi va daemon-reload'ni o'zi qiladi
sudo systemctl edit app
```

| Buyruq | Nimani qayta o'qiydi |
|---|---|
| `systemctl daemon-reload` | systemd unit fayllari |
| `systemctl reload app` | ilovaning o'z config'i (nginx.conf) |
| `systemctl daemon-reexec` | systemd binarining o'zi (yangilanishdan keyin) |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `daemon-reload` ishlab turgan jarayonga ta'sir qilmaydi — `[Service]` o'zgarishlari uchun `restart` ham kerak.
- Ansible'da `systemd: daemon_reload: yes` ni unutish — "o'zgarish qo'llanmadi" bug'i.
- Juda ko'p unit'li tizimda daemon-reload bir necha soniya olishi mumkin; loop'da chaqirmang.

**Senior nuqta:** Unit o'zgarishini doim `systemctl show -p <Property>` bilan tekshiring — fayldagi qiymat va haqiqiy qo'llangan qiymat farqli bo'lishi mumkin (drop-in ustuvorligi).

31289.a:
```
systemctl status app -l --no-pager     # Active: failed? exit code? oxirgi loglar
journalctl -u app -e                    # oxiriga sakra
journalctl -u app -b --since "10 min ago"
systemctl cat app                       # haqiqiy unit (drop-in'lar bilan)
systemctl show app -p ExecStart,User,WorkingDirectory,Environment
systemctl list-units --failed
```
Status'da qarash kerak: `Active: failed (Result: exit-code)`, `code=exited, status=203/EXEC` (binary topilmadi / ruxsat yo'q), `status=217/USER` (user yo'q), `status=200/CHDIR`, `Result: oom-kill`, `start-limit-hit`.

Keyin: o'sha user bilan qo'lda: `sudo -u app /opt/app/bin/app --config ...` — xatoni bevosita ko'rasan.
`start-limit-hit` bo'lsa: tuzat, keyin `systemctl reset-failed app`.

31290.a:
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/app.service
[Unit]
Description=Payments API
After=network-online.target postgresql.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=app
Group=app
WorkingDirectory=/opt/app
EnvironmentFile=/etc/app/app.env
ExecStart=/opt/app/bin/api --config /etc/app/config.yaml
ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
TimeoutStopSec=30s
KillSignal=SIGTERM
LimitNOFILE=65536
# hardening
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/app
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
```
sudo useradd -r -s /usr/sbin/nologin app
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now app
```
`/etc/systemd/system/` — admin unit'lari (ustun), `/lib/systemd/system/` (`/usr/lib/...`) — paket unit'lari. Paket faylini tahrirlama — drop-in ishlat.

31291.a:
| Type | "Started" qachon | Qachon ishlat |
|---|---|---|
| `simple` (default) | fork() dan darhol | foreground daemon (Go, Node) |
| `exec` | exec() o'tgach | simple'ga o'xshash, lekin binary yo'q bo'lsa start xato beradi |
| `forking` | ota jarayon exit qilgach (`PIDFile=`) | eski daemonlar o'zini background'ga tashlaydi |
| `oneshot` | jarayon tugagach | skript, migration; `RemainAfterExit=yes` bilan |
| `notify` | `sd_notify("READY=1")` | postgres, ilova haqiqatan tayyor bo'lganda |
| `idle` | boshqa job'lar tugagach | kam |

Senior nuqta: `After=postgresql.service` faqat postgres "started" bo'lishini kutadi. Agar postgres `simple` bo'lsa — hali port ochilmagan bo'lishi mumkin. Shuning uchun `notify` + ilovada retry/backoff baribir kerak (dependency ordering != readiness).

31292.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `Restart=` — servis to'xtaganda systemd uni qachon qayta ishga tushirishini belgilaydi (`no`, `on-failure`, `on-abnormal`, `always` va h.k.). `StartLimitIntervalSec` + `StartLimitBurst` — crash-loop himoyasi: belgilangan vaqtda N martadan ko'p start bo'lsa systemd taslim bo'ladi va unit `failed` holatga o'tadi.

| Qiymat | Exit != 0 | Signal/timeout/watchdog | Exit 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `no` (default) | - | - | - |
| `on-failure` | ha | ha | - |
| `on-abnormal` | - | ha | - |
| `always` | ha | ha | ha |

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
crash -> RestartSec (2s) -> start -> crash -> ...
   60s ichida 5 start? -> ha -> "start request repeated too quickly" -> failed
                                  OnFailure= -> alert unit
```

**Amalda:**
```ini
[Unit]
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=5
OnFailure=alert@%n.service

[Service]
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
# systemd 254+: exponential backoff
RestartSteps=5
RestartMaxDelaySec=60
```
```bash
systemctl show app -p NRestarts -p Result
journalctl -u app -n 30
sudo systemctl reset-failed app && sudo systemctl start app   # tuzatgandan keyin
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `StartLimit*` ni `[Service]` ga yozish — yangi systemd'da e'tiborsiz qoldiriladi (ogohlantirish beradi).
- `Restart=always` + noto'g'ri config = cheksiz loop, log to'lishi; StartLimit bo'lmasa.
- `RestartSec` juda kichik — tashqi bog'liqlik (DB) tiklanishiga vaqt bermaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Restart simptomni yashiradi: `NRestarts` va `failed` holatni metrikaga chiqarib alert qiling. Backoff (`RestartSteps`) tashqi xizmat o'chganda "thundering herd" ni kamaytiradi.

31293.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Ikki xil savolni ajrating: **nima** birga ishga tushadi (`Wants`, `Requires`, `BindsTo`, `PartOf`) va **qaysi tartibda** (`After`, `Before`). Ular mustaqil — `Requires=` tartib bermaydi, `After=` esa bog'liqlik yaratmaydi.

| Direktiva | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `Wants=X` | X ni ham ishga tushir; X yiqilsa men davom etaman (yumshoq) |
| `Requires=X` | X ishga tushmasa yoki stop qilinsa — men ham to'xtayman |
| `BindsTo=X` | Requires'dan kuchli: X yo'qolsa (device uzildi) darhol to'xtayman |
| `PartOf=X` | X restart/stop bo'lsa men ham (bir tomonlama) |
| `Conflicts=X` | birga ishlay olmaydi |
| `After=X` | X ishga tushib bo'lgach meni boshla |
| `Before=X` | mendan keyin X |

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Requires=postgresql.service   (After yo'q)
   -> app va postgres PARALLEL start -> app DB'ga ulana olmaydi -> crash

Requires=postgresql.service
After=postgresql.service
   -> postgres "started" -> keyin app
```

**Amalda:**
```ini
[Unit]
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
Requires=postgresql.service
After=postgresql.service
```
```bash
systemctl list-dependencies app
systemctl list-dependencies --reverse postgresql
systemd-analyze critical-chain app.service
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/app.service
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Requires=` bor, `After=` yo'q — klassik xato, ikkalasi parallel.
- `After=network.target` tarmoq "tayyor" ekanini anglatmaydi — `network-online.target` + `Wants=` kerak.
- "started" — `Type=` ga bog'liq: `simple` darhol "started" hisoblanadi, DB hali ulanishga tayyor bo'lmasligi mumkin; `Type=notify` aniqroq.

**Senior nuqta:** systemd tartibi faqat startup'ni hal qiladi; tarmoq bog'liqliklari runtime'da ham uziladi. Ilova baribir retry/backoff bilan ulanishni bilishi kerak — unit dependency buning o'rnini bosmaydi.

31294.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Paket unit faylini (`/usr/lib/systemd/system/nginx.service`) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tahrirlamang — paket yangilanishida ustidan yoziladi. To'g'ri yo'l: **drop-in** (`/etc/systemd/system/nginx.service.d/override.conf`) — `sudo systemctl edit nginx` uni yaratadi va `daemon-reload` ni o'zi qiladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi (ustuvorlik):**
```
/etc/systemd/system/nginx.service          (admin, eng yuqori)
/run/systemd/system/                        (runtime)
/usr/lib/systemd/system/nginx.service       (paket)
  + /etc/systemd/system/nginx.service.d/*.conf  (drop-in, faqat o'zgargan qatorlar)
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
sudo systemctl edit nginx
```
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/nginx.service.d/override.conf
[Service]
LimitNOFILE=200000
Restart=on-failure
```
Ro'yxatli direktivani (`ExecStart`) almashtirish — avval bo'sh qiymat bilan tozalash:
```ini
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/nginx -g 'daemon off;' -c /etc/nginx/custom.conf
```
```bash
systemctl cat nginx            # asosiy fayl + barcha drop-in'lar
systemd-delta --type=extended,overridden
sudo systemctl edit --full nginx   # to'liq nusxa /etc'ga (kamdan-kam)
sudo systemctl revert nginx    # barcha override'larni olib tashlash
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ExecStart=` ni tozalamasdan ikkinchisini qo'shish — "has more than one ExecStart" xatosi.
- `edit --full` — paketdagi keyingi tuzatishlar (xavfsizlik) sizga kelmaydi.
- Drop-in'da `[Service]` sarlavhasini unutish — qator e'tiborsiz qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** Drop-in'lar config management uchun ideal: Ansible faqat kichik `override.conf` ni boshqaradi. Shu usul bilan paket servislariga hardening qo'shish mumkin (`ProtectSystem=strict`, `NoNewPrivileges=yes`) va natijani `systemd-analyze security nginx` bilan baholash.

31295.a:
```
journalctl -u nginx              # bitta unit
journalctl -u nginx -u app -f    # bir nechta, real vaqt (tail -f)
journalctl -e                    # oxiriga sakra
journalctl -n 100 --no-pager     # oxirgi 100 qator
journalctl -b                    # joriy boot; -b -1 = oldingi boot (crash tahlili!)
journalctl --list-boots
journalctl --since "2026-10-02 10:00" --until "1 hour ago"
journalctl -p err -b             # priority: emerg..debug (0-7), err va yuqori
journalctl -k                    # kernel (dmesg) — OOM, disk xatolari
journalctl _PID=1234
journalctl -o json-pretty / -o cat / -o short-iso
journalctl -g "timeout"          # grep (pattern)
journalctl --disk-usage
journalctl --vacuum-size=500M    # / --vacuum-time=7d
```
Oldingi boot loglari saqlanishi uchun persistent journal kerak: `/var/log/journal` mavjud bo'lsin yoki `Storage=persistent` (`/etc/systemd/journald.conf`).

31296.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `/etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/size.conf` da hajm limitlarini (`SystemMaxUse`, `SystemKeepFree`, `MaxRetentionSec`) qo'yasiz, journald'ni restart qilasiz va eski log'larni `journalctl --vacuum-*` bilan darhol tozalaysiz.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Storage=persistent -> /var/log/journal (diskda)
Storage=volatile   -> /run/log/journal (RAM, reboot'da yo'qoladi)
Default limit: fayl tizimining 10% (max 4G) -> katta diskda ko'p joy
```

**Amalda:**
```ini
# /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/size.conf
[Journal]
Storage=persistent
SystemMaxUse=1G
SystemKeepFree=2G
MaxRetentionSec=14day
RateLimitIntervalSec=30s
RateLimitBurst=10000
```
```bash
sudo systemctl restart systemd-journald
journalctl --disk-usage              # Archived and active journals take up 3.9G
sudo journalctl --vacuum-size=1G
sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=7d
journalctl --verify                  # buzilgan fayllar
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- journald + rsyslog ikkalasi yozsa — log ikki marta joy oladi (`/var/log/syslog` + journal). Bittasini tanlang yoki rsyslog'ni faqat forward uchun qoldiring.
- Rate limit oshganda `Suppressed N messages` — log jim yo'qoladi; debug paytida muhim xabarlar ketishi mumkin.
- Bitta "shovqinli" servis butun limitni yeydi — uni o'zida tuzating (log level), limitni emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Server diskini log ombori qilmang: log'larni markaziy tizimga (Loki, ELK, CloudWatch) jo'nating va lokalda qisqa muddat saqlang. Xavfsizlik log'lari (auth) uchun esa saqlash muddati compliance talabiga mos bo'lsin va markaziy joyda o'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan holda saqlansin.

31297.a:
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/backup.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/opt/bin/backup.sh

# /etc/systemd/system/backup.timer
[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:30:00
Persistent=true          # server o'chiq bo'lsa, yoqilganda bajaradi
RandomizedDelaySec=10m   # fleet'da bir vaqtda urilmasin
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
```
```
systemctl enable --now backup.timer
systemctl list-timers
systemd-analyze calendar "Mon..Fri 09:00"
```
| | cron | timer |
|---|---|---|
| Log | mail / syslog | `journalctl -u backup` |
| O'tkazib yuborilgan | yo'q (anacron bor) | `Persistent=true` |
| Bir vaqtda 2 nusxa | bo'lishi mumkin (`flock` kerak) | yo'q, unit allaqachon active |
| Limit | yo'q | CPUQuota, MemoryMax |

31298.a:
```
# m   h   dom mon dow  command
*/5   *   *   *   *    /opt/bin/check.sh            # har 5 daqiqa
0     2   *   *   *    /opt/bin/backup.sh           # har kuni 02:00
30    9   *   *   1-5  ...                          # ish kunlari 09:30
0     0   1   *   *    ...                          # har oy 1-sanasi
@reboot                ...                          # boot'da
```
- `crontab -e` tahrirlash, `-l` ko'rish, `-r` **o'chirish (ehtiyot: -e yonida!)**, `-u bob -l`.
- `/etc/crontab`, `/etc/cron.d/app`: `0 2 * * * root /opt/bin/backup.sh` (user maydoni bor).
- `/etc/cron.daily/` va h.k. — run-parts.

Tuzoqlar: cron'da **PATH minimal** (`/usr/bin:/bin`), env yo'q, `%` maxsus belgi (`\%` qil), output mail'ga ketadi — `>> /var/log/job.log 2>&1` yoz. Timezone — server TZ (`CRON_TZ`). Uzoq job ustma-ust tushmasin: `flock -n /tmp/job.lock cmd`.

31299.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Cron sizning interaktiv shell muhitingizda ishlamaydi: `PATH` minimal (`/usr/bin:/bin`), shell `/bin/sh`, `.bashrc` o'qilmaydi, ishchi papka `$HOME`, `%` maxsus belgi. Avval cron umuman ishga tushirdimi va qanday xato berdi — shuni ushlash kerak.

**Qadamlar:**
```
1. Cron ishga tushirdimi?   -> journalctl -u cron / grep CRON /var/log/syslog
2. Chiqishni ushla          -> >> /tmp/job.log 2>&1
3. Muhit farqi              -> PATH, SHELL, cwd, env, %
4. Taqlid qil               -> env -i ... /opt/job.sh
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
grep CRON /var/log/syslog | tail          # RHEL: /var/log/cron, servis crond
crontab -l
# crontab:
SHELL=/bin/bash
PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
MAILTO=""
*/5 * * * * cd /opt/app && ./job.sh >> /var/log/job.log 2>&1
0 2 * * * tar czf /backup/$(date +\%F).tgz /data      # % ni escape!
# cron muhitini taqlid qilish:
env -i SHELL=/bin/sh PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$HOME /bin/sh -c '/opt/job.sh'
```

**Sabablar:**
| Sabab | Belgi | Yechim |
|---|---|---|
| PATH | `docker: not found` | absolut yo'l / `PATH=` |
| sh vs bash | `[[: not found` | shebang `#!/bin/bash` |
| cwd | nisbiy fayl topilmadi | `cd` yoki absolut yo'l |
| `%` | buyruq kesilgan | `\%` |
| env yo'q | token/kalit bo'sh | `EnvironmentFile` / skriptda source |
| huquq | Permission denied | `chmod +x`, shebang |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Chiqish yo'naltirilmasa xato `MAILTO` ga ketadi (ko'pincha hech kim o'qimaydi) — jim yiqiladi.
- `/etc/cron.d/` fayllarida foydalanuvchi ustuni bor, `crontab -e` da yo'q.
- Secret'larni crontab qatoriga yozish — `ps` va log'larda ko'rinadi; root-only fayldan o'qing.

**Senior nuqta:** Ko'p muammolar systemd timer'ga o'tish bilan yo'qoladi: muhit aniq (`Environment=`), log journald'da, exit status ko'rinadi. Muhim job'lar uchun "ishga tushmadi" alerti (dead man's switch) qo'ying.

31300.a:
```ini
[Service]
MemoryHigh=1.5G          # throttling + reclaim boshlanadi
MemoryMax=2G             # oshsa cgroup ichida OOM kill
CPUQuota=150%            # 1.5 core
TasksMax=512             # fork-bomb himoyasi
IOWeight=100
# hardening
DynamicUser=yes
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE   # root'siz 80/443
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX
```
```
systemd-cgtop                         # cgroup bo'yicha CPU/RAM
systemctl set-property app MemoryMax=1G   # runtime'da
systemd-analyze security app          # 0-10 exposure ball
```
Senior: Docker'dagi `--memory` ham aynan shu cgroup mexanizmi. Bitta host'da ko'p servis bo'lsa limit'siz bitta leak hammasini o'ldiradi (noisy neighbour).

31301.a:
Ketma-ketlik:
1. `ExecStop=` (bo'lsa).
2. `KillSignal=` (default SIGTERM) — `KillMode=control-group` (default) bo'yicha cgroup'dagi **hamma** jarayonga.
3. `TimeoutStopSec=` (default 90s) kutadi.
4. Hali tirik bo'lsa — `SIGKILL` (`FinalKillSignal`).

`KillMode`: `control-group` | `mixed` (SIGTERM faqat main, SIGKILL hammaga) | `process` (faqat main — child'lar yetim qoladi, xavfli) | `none`.

Ilova tomoni (Go): SIGTERM ushla -> yangi so'rov qabul qilmaslik -> in-flight tugat -> DB/Kafka yop:
```go
ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGTERM, os.Interrupt)
defer stop()
<-ctx.Done()
shCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 25*time.Second)
defer cancel()
srv.Shutdown(shCtx)
```
Qoida: ilova shutdown vaqti < `TimeoutStopSec` (K8s'da < `terminationGracePeriodSeconds`).

31302.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **Socket activation** — portni (yoki unix socket'ni) systemd o'zi ochib ushlab turadi va birinchi ulanish kelganda servisni ishga tushiradi; servis restart bo'lganda ulanishlar kernel backlog'ida kutadi va yo'qolmaydi. **`systemd-analyze`** — boot vaqti, sekin unit'lar, kritik zanjir, unit xatolari va xavfsizlik bahosini ko'rsatadigan diagnostika vositasi.

**Socket activation qanday ishlaydi:**
```
boot: systemd -> socket(8080) listen   (servis hali yo'q)
ulanish keldi -> systemd app.service'ni start qiladi, FD'ni beradi (LISTEN_FDS)
app restart   -> socket systemd'da ochiq qoladi -> yangi ulanishlar backlog'da kutadi
```

**Amalda:**
```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/app.socket
[Socket]
ListenStream=8080
[Install]
WantedBy=sockets.target

# /etc/systemd/system/app.service
[Service]
ExecStart=/opt/app/server      # FD 3 dan socket oladi (sd_listen_fds)
```
```bash
sudo systemctl enable --now app.socket
systemctl list-sockets
```
**systemd-analyze:**
```bash
systemd-analyze                     # Startup finished in 2.1s (firmware) + 1.3s (kernel) + 8.4s (userspace)
systemd-analyze blame | head        # eng sekin unit'lar
systemd-analyze critical-chain      # boot'ni haqiqatan kim ushlab turdi
systemd-analyze verify app.service  # unit sintaksis xatolari
systemd-analyze security app        # 0-10 ekspozitsiya bahosi
systemd-analyze plot > boot.svg
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ilova socket'ni o'zi ochishga harakat qilsa — "address in use"; kodda `sd_listen_fds` qo'llab-quvvatlash kerak.
- `blame` parallel unit'larni ko'rsatadi — uzoq unit boot'ni sekinlashtirmagan bo'lishi mumkin; `critical-chain` haqiqiy yo'l.
- Socket activation'da birinchi so'rov servis start vaqtini kutadi (cold start).

**Senior nuqta:** `systemd-analyze security` ni CI'da ishlatib har yangi unit uchun minimal hardening talab qiling (`NoNewPrivileges`, `ProtectSystem`, `PrivateTmp`, `CapabilityBoundingSet`). Bu himoyani kod o'zgarishisiz qo'shishning eng arzon yo'li.

31303.a:
```
client                                   server (sshd :22)
  | ---- TCP SYN ---------------------> |
  | <--- SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_9.x ---------- |
  | ---- key exchange (curve25519) ---> |  -> umumiy session key
  | <--- host key + imzo -------------- |  -> known_hosts bilan solishtir
  | ---- user auth (publickey) -------> |  -> authorized_keys
  | ==== shifrlangan kanallar ========= |  shell, scp/sftp, tunnel
```
- **Host key** — serverni tasdiqlaydi (MITM'dan himoya). Birinchi ulanishda *"The authenticity of host ... can't be established"* — fingerprint'ni tekshir.
- **User key** — sizni tasdiqlaydi.
- Fayllar: server `/etc/ssh/sshd_config`, client `~/.ssh/config`, `~/.ssh/known_hosts`, `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`.

31304.a:
```
# 1. Client'da kalit
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "mansur@laptop" -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519   # passphrase qo'y!
# 2. Public kalitni serverga
ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub deploy@10.0.0.5
#   qo'lda: cat id_ed25519.pub | ssh deploy@host 'mkdir -p ~/.ssh && cat >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys'
# 3. Server'da ruxsatlar (aks holda sshd kalitni rad etadi, StrictModes)
chmod 700 ~/.ssh
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown -R deploy:deploy ~/.ssh
# 4. Sinab ko'r (eski sessiyani YOPMA)
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 deploy@10.0.0.5
```
- Private key (`id_ed25519`) **hech qachon** serverga/git'ga ketmaydi, `chmod 600`.
- ed25519 > RSA (qisqa, tez, xavfsiz). RSA kerak bo'lsa `-b 4096`.
- Kalitni 1 marta kiritish: `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` (ssh-agent).

31306.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `~/.ssh/config` — SSH mijozining shaxsiy sozlama fayli: har host uchun taxallus, manzil, foydalanuvchi, kalit, port, bastion (ProxyJump), port forwarding va keep-alive'ni bir marta yozib qo'yasiz. Natijada uzun `ssh -i ... -p ... -J ...` o'rniga `ssh prod-db`.

**Muammo:** 30 ta server, har birida boshqa user, kalit va bastion. Buyruqlarni eslab qolish va har safar yozish — xato va vaqt yo'qotish.

**Amalda:**
```
# ~/.ssh/config   (chmod 600)
Host bastion
    HostName 203.0.113.10
    User mansur
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

Host prod-*
    User deploy
    ProxyJump bastion
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
    IdentitiesOnly yes

Host prod-db
    HostName 10.0.1.20
    LocalForward 5432 localhost:5432

Host *
    ServerAliveInterval 30
    ServerAliveCountMax 3
    AddKeysToAgent yes
    HashKnownHosts yes
```
```bash
ssh prod-db            # bastion orqali kiradi + lokal 5432 ochiladi
ssh -G prod-db | grep -E '^(user|hostname|proxyjump)'   # yakuniy qiymatlar
```

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ssh prod-db -> fayl yuqoridan pastga o'qiladi
  "prod-db" mos  -> HostName, LocalForward
  "prod-*"  mos  -> User, ProxyJump, IdentityFile
  "*"       mos  -> ServerAlive...
  Har parametr uchun BIRINCHI topilgan qiymat g'olib
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `Host *` ni boshiga qo'yish — uning qiymatlari keyingi aniq host'larni bosib ketadi; umumiy blok oxirida.
- `IdentitiesOnly yes` siz agent'dagi barcha kalitlar sinaladi -> "Too many authentication failures".
- Fayl huquqi keng bo'lsa (`644` boshqa yozishi mumkin) SSH "Bad owner or permissions" bilan rad etadi.

**Senior nuqta:** `ssh -G host` — yakuniy konfiguratsiyani ko'rishning eng tez yo'li. Jamoa uchun umumiy config'ni `Include ~/.ssh/config.d/*` bilan alohida faylda versiyalang; secret (kalit) hech qachon repozitoriyga tushmasin.

31307.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `-L` (local forward) — lokal portni SSH orqali uzoqdagi manzilga ulaydi (private DB'ga lokaldan kirish). `-R` (remote forward) — server tomondagi portni sizning lokal servisingizga ulaydi (NAT ortidagi servisni ko'rsatish). `-D` (dynamic) — lokal SOCKS5 proxy, istalgan manzilga SSH server orqali chiqish.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
-L 5432:db.internal:5432 bastion
  [siz] localhost:5432 ==ssh==> bastion ---> db.internal:5432

-R 9000:localhost:3000 vps
  internet -> vps:9000 ==ssh==> [siz] localhost:3000

-D 1080 bastion
  brauzer (SOCKS localhost:1080) ==ssh==> bastion ---> istalgan host:port
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ssh -N -f -L 5432:db.internal:5432 bastion   # -N buyruqsiz, -f fonga
psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U app
ssh -N -R 9000:localhost:3000 vps            # tashqaridan ochiq bo'lishi uchun sshd: GatewayPorts
ssh -N -D 1080 bastion
curl --socks5-hostname localhost:1080 http://intranet.local
ss -tlnp | grep 5432                         # tunnel tinglayaptimi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `-L 0.0.0.0:5432:...` — tunnelni tarmoqdagi boshqa mashinalarga ham ochadi; default `127.0.0.1` qoldiring.
- `-R` bilan ichki servisni internetga chiqarish — firewall va xavfsizlik siyosatini chetlab o'tish.
- Uzoq yashovchi tunnel uziladi — `autossh` yoki `ServerAliveInterval`.

**Senior nuqta (himoya):** Tunnel'lar perimetr nazoratini chetlab o'tadi. Server tomonda: `AllowTcpForwarding no` (default) va faqat bastion'da `yes`, `PermitOpen db.internal:5432` bilan manzillarni cheklash, `GatewayPorts no`, `PermitTunnel no`. Ma'lumotlar bazasiga doimiy kirish uchun esa audit qilinadigan yechim (SSM port forwarding, Teleport) yaxshiroq.

31308.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **ProxyJump** (`-J`) — mijoz bastion orqali TCP tunnel ochadi va uning ichida target bilan **to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, end-to-end** SSH sessiya quradi; kalit va autentifikatsiya mijozda qoladi. **Agent forwarding** (`-A`) — bastion'da sizning SSH agent'ingizga ulanadigan socket paydo bo'ladi; bastion'dagi root (yoki hujumchi) shu socket orqali **sizning nomingizdan** boshqa serverlarga kira oladi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ProxyJump:
 [laptop: kalit] ==SSH(bastion)==> bastion --TCP--> target
 [laptop] ======== shifrlangan SSH (end-to-end) =======> target
 bastion faqat baytlarni uzatadi, ichini ko'rmaydi

Agent forwarding:
 [laptop: agent] <==socket== bastion:$SSH_AUTH_SOCK
 bastion root: SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/tmp/ssh-xxx/agent.123 ssh prod-db  -> SIZ sifatida kiradi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
ssh -J mansur@bastion deploy@10.0.1.20
ssh -J b1,b2 target                  # zanjir
# ~/.ssh/config
# Host prod-*
#     ProxyJump bastion
#     ForwardAgent no
```
Agent forwarding'dan qochib bo'lmasa:
```bash
ssh-add -c ~/.ssh/id_ed25519   # har ishlatishda tasdiq so'raydi
ssh-add -t 1h ~/.ssh/id_ed25519   # vaqt cheklovi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Bastion'da `git pull` uchun `-A` ishlatish — keng tarqalgan, lekin xavfli odat; deploy key yoki ProxyJump bilan almashtiring.
- ProxyJump uchun bastion'da `AllowTcpForwarding yes` kerak (faqat bastion'da).
- Eski `ProxyCommand ssh -W %h:%p bastion` ham ishlaydi, lekin `ProxyJump` soddaroq (OpenSSH 7.3+).

**Senior nuqta (himoya):** Qoida: `-J` ishlat, `-A` dan qoch. Bastion'da `AllowAgentForwarding no` bilan server tomonda ham yoping, bastion'ni minimal (shell'siz, faqat forwarding) qiling va barcha sessiyalarni audit log'ga yozing.

31309.a:
```
ssh -vvv deploy@host 2>&1 | grep -Ei "offering|identity|denied|auth"
```
Server tomonda (boshqa sessiyadan):
```
sudo journalctl -u ssh -f        # Ubuntu: ssh, RHEL: sshd
sudo tail -f /var/log/auth.log   # /var/log/secure (RHEL)
```
Tipik sabablar:
- *"Authentication refused: bad ownership or modes for directory /home/deploy"* — home `g+w`, `.ssh` 700 emas, `authorized_keys` 600 emas, egasi boshqa.
- Noto'g'ri kalit taklif qilinmoqda — `-i` + `IdentitiesOnly yes`.
- Kalit boshqa user'ning authorized_keys'ida.
- `AllowUsers`/`AllowGroups` da yo'q, `PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms` — eski `ssh-rsa` (SHA1) OpenSSH 8.8+ da o'chiq.
- SELinux: `restorecon -Rv ~/.ssh`.
- authorized_keys'da qator bo'linib ketgan (copy-paste).

31310.a:
Nega muhim: host key — serverning "pasporti". O'zgarsa — yo server qayta yaratilgan, yo kimdir o'rtada turibdi.

To'g'ri tartib:
1. Infra jamoasi/cloud'dan tasdiqla: server rebuild qilinganmi? IP boshqa VM'ga o'tganmi?
2. Haqiqiy fingerprint'ni ishonchli kanal orqali ol (cloud console serial output, `ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub` konsoldan).
3. Keyin:
```
ssh-keygen -R 10.0.0.5
ssh deploy@10.0.0.5     # yangi fingerprint'ni solishtirib qabul qil
```
**Qilma:** `StrictHostKeyChecking no` + `UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null` ni doimiy qo'yish — MITM'ga ochiq eshik. Avtomatlashtirishda: host key'larni oldindan tarqat (`ssh-keyscan` ishonchli tarmoqda) yoki SSH host sertifikatlar.

31311.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **scp** — oddiy nusxalash (bir martalik fayl). **rsync** — faqat farqni yuboradi, uzilsa davom etadi, huquq/vaqtni saqlaydi, `--delete` bilan sinxronlaydi (katta yoki takroriy ko'chirish). **sftp** — interaktiv fayl sessiyasi (`ls`, `get`, `put`), ko'pincha cheklangan foydalanuvchilar uchun.

| | scp | rsync | sftp |
|---|---|---|---|
| Delta (faqat farq) | yo'q | ha | yo'q |
| Uzilsa davom | yo'q | `-P` | `reget` |
| Sinxronlash | yo'q | `--delete` | yo'q |
| Interaktiv | yo'q | yo'q | ha |

**Amalda:**
```bash
scp file.tar.gz deploy@host:/tmp/
scp -r -P 2222 dir/ host:/opt/              # -P katta harf = port (ssh'da -p!)
rsync -avzP --delete -n ./site/ host:/var/www/site/   # AVVAL dry-run
rsync -avzP --delete ./site/ host:/var/www/site/
#  -a arxiv (rekursiv, perms, owner, time, symlink)  -z siqish
#  -P progress + partial                             --delete manbada yo'qni o'chir
rsync -e "ssh -p 2222" --bwlimit=10m ...
sftp deploy@host   # sftp> put file ; get file ; ls
```

**Trailing slash tuzog'i:**
```
rsync src/ dst/   -> src ICHIDAGILAR dst/ ga
rsync src  dst/   -> dst/src/ papkasi yaratiladi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `--delete` + noto'g'ri yo'l (yoki slash) = manzildagi ma'lumot o'chadi; doim `-n` bilan boshlang.
- `scp -p` (kichik) — vaqtni saqlash, port emas.
- OpenSSH 9.0+ da `scp` ichkarida SFTP protokolini ishlatadi; eski serverlarda `-O` kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Faqat fayl almashish kerak bo'lgan hamkorlar uchun `ForceCommand internal-sftp` + `ChrootDirectory` — shell'siz, papkaga qamalgan sftp; bu shell kirishni berishdan ancha xavfsiz.

31312.a:
Muammo: 200 server x 30 kishi; ketgan xodim kaliti hamma joyda qoladi, kim qachon kirganini bilmaysan.

**SSH CA:**
```
ssh-keygen -s ca_key -I mansur -n deploy -V +8h id_ed25519.pub   # 8 soatlik sertifikat
# server: TrustedUserCAKeys /etc/ssh/ca.pub
```
- Serverda authorized_keys yo'q, sertifikat 8 soatda o'ladi — offboarding avtomatik.
- Host sertifikatlar — known_hosts muammosi yo'qoladi.

**Yondashuvlar:** Vault SSH / step-ca + SSO; Teleport (session recording, RBAC); AWS SSM Session Manager (22-port umuman yopiq, IAM + CloudTrail).

Shart: MFA, least privilege (`deploy` vs `root`, sudo cheklangan), audit log markaziy, break-glass kalit seyfda. Ideal: prod'ga SSH umuman kerak bo'lmasin (immutable infra) — SSH = istisno, qoida emas.

31313.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Sekinlik deyarli doim autentifikatsiyadan **oldin yoki keyin** kutishda: server client IP'ning teskari DNS'ini qidiradi (`UseDNS`), GSSAPI/Kerberos timeout, agent'dagi ko'p kalitlar, PAM/LDAP sekinligi yoki login skriptlari (`motd`, `.bashrc`). `ssh -vvv` vaqt belgilari bilan qaysi qadamda kutayotganini ko'rsatadi.

**Qadamlar:**
```
ssh -vvv -> qaysi qatordan keyin 10s pauza?
  "Connecting to..." keyin       -> tarmoq / DNS (client tomonda)
  "SSH2_MSG_KEXINIT" oldidan      -> server UseDNS (PTR qidiruv)
  "gssapi-with-mic" da            -> GSSAPI timeout
  "Authenticated" dan keyin       -> PAM, motd, shell init
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
time ssh -vvv host exit 2>&1 | ts -s     # ts: moreutils, har qatorga vaqt
ssh -o GSSAPIAuthentication=no host      # tezlashdimi?
time ssh host true                       # tez bo'lsa -> muammo .bashrc da
```
Server tomonda (`/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/perf.conf`):
```
UseDNS no
GSSAPIAuthentication no
```
Mijoz tomonda (`~/.ssh/config`):
```
Host *
    IdentitiesOnly yes
    ControlMaster auto
    ControlPath ~/.ssh/cm-%r@%h:%p
    ControlPersist 10m
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `pam_motd` va `/etc/update-motd.d/` skriptlari internetga chiqadi (yangiliklar, paketlar) — yopiq tarmoqda timeout.
- LDAP/SSSD sekin bo'lsa har login 10s+ — SSSD keshini tekshiring.
- `ControlMaster` bilan ochiq socket — kim unga kira olsa, sizning sessiyangizni ishlatadi; `~/.ssh` huquqlari 700 bo'lsin.

**Senior nuqta:** Ansible minglab ulanish qiladi — `ControlPersist` va `pipelining=True` bilan ish vaqti bir necha barobar qisqaradi. Diagnostikada "bitta o'zgaruvchini o'zgartir, qayta o'lcha" tamoyiliga amal qiling.

31314.a:
**Qisqa javob:** **fail2ban** — log'larni kuzatib, qisqa vaqtda ko'p muvaffaqiyatsiz login qilgan IP'ni firewall orqali vaqtincha bloklaydigan dastur. Lekin brute-force'dan asosiy himoya — bu **parol bilan kirishni o'chirish** va SSH'ni faqat ishonchli tarmoqlarga ochish; fail2ban esa qo'shimcha qatlam (log shovqini va resurs sarfini kamaytiradi).

**Himoya qatlamlari:**
```
1. Tarmoq:  SG / ufw -> 22 faqat VPN/ofis/bastion IP'lariga
2. Autent.: PasswordAuthentication no -> brute-force ma'nosiz
3. Bastion: tashqaridan faqat bitta kirish nuqtasi, MFA
4. fail2ban: qolgan shovqinni bloklash
5. Kuzatuv: auth log -> SIEM, g'ayritabiiy kirishlarga alert
```

**Amalda:**
```ini
# /etc/fail2ban/jail.local
[DEFAULT]
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 10.0.0.0/8
[sshd]
enabled  = true
backend  = systemd
maxretry = 5
findtime = 10m
bantime  = 1h
bantime.increment = true     # takrorlovchilarga uzoqroq ban
```
```bash
sudo fail2ban-client status sshd
sudo fail2ban-client set sshd unbanip 1.2.3.4
sudo ufw allow from 10.0.0.0/8 to any port 22 proto tcp
sudo lastb | head            # muvaffaqiyatsiz urinishlar
last -n 10 ; who
journalctl -u ssh --since today | grep -E 'Failed|Accepted'
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `ignoreip` siz o'z ofis IP'ingizni ban qilish (ayniqsa NAT ortida ko'p xodim bo'lsa).
- Botnet ko'p IP'dan oz-ozdan urinadi — fail2ban ushlamaydi; shuning uchun parolsiz kirish asosiy.
- `jail.conf` ni tahrirlash — paket yangilanishida yo'qoladi.

**Senior nuqta:** `Accepted publickey` log'larini ham kuzating — muvaffaqiyatli, lekin g'ayritabiiy kirish (noma'lum IP, tungi vaqt) muvaffaqiyatsizlardan ko'ra xavfliroq. Cloud'da SSH'ni butunlay yopib SSM/Teleport ishlatish — eng kuchli himoya.

31315.a:
**0. Kirish.** SSH ishlamasa: cloud serial console / IPMI. SSH sekin bo'lsa ham bitta sessiya ochib qo'y.

**1. Umumiy rasm (60s checklist, Brendan Gregg):**
```
uptime                 # load average 1/5/15 — o'syaptimi?
dmesg -T | tail -50    # OOM killer, disk I/O error, hung task, segfault
vmstat 1 5             # r (run queue), b (D-state), si/so (swap), wa, st
mpstat -P ALL 1 3      # bitta core 100%mi?
pidstat 1 3            # qaysi jarayon CPU
iostat -xz 1 3         # %util, await, aqu-sz
free -m                # available, swap
sar -n DEV 1 3         # tarmoq
top / htop             # P CPU, M RAM bo'yicha
```
**2. Shoxlanish:**
| Belgi | Ehtimol | Keyin |
|---|---|---|
| `us` yuqori | ilova CPU | `top -H -p PID`, `perf top`, pprof |
| `sy` yuqori | syscall/kernel | `strace -c -p`, `perf` |
| `wa` yuqori, `b`>0 | disk | `iostat -x`, `iotop -o` |
| `si/so` > 0 | RAM yetmaydi, swap | `ps aux --sort=-rss`, OOM |
| `st` yuqori | VM qo'shnisi (steal) | instance turini almashtir |
| load yuqori, CPU past | D-state (NFS/disk) | `ps -eo stat,pid,wchan,cmd \| grep ^D` |

**3. Disk/FD/tarmoq:** `df -h`, `df -i`, `ss -s`, `ss -tanp | wc -l`, `ls /proc/PID/fd | wc -l`.
**4. Loglar:** `journalctl -p err -b`, `journalctl -u app --since "15 min ago"`.
**5. Mitigation:** trafikni yo'naltir/rollback/restart — lekin **oldin dalil yig'** (`top -b -n1 > snap`, goroutine dump). Keyin postmortem.

31316.a:
```
load average: 7.80, 4.10, 2.00      # 1, 5, 15 daqiqa; o'syapti
%Cpu(s): 12 us, 3 sy, 0 ni, 40 id, 45 wa, 0 hi, 0 si, 0 st
```
- **load**: `nproc`=8 bo'lsa 8 — to'liq band; lekin Linux'da D-state ham kiradi, shuning uchun load yuqori + CPU bo'sh = IO/NFS.
- **us** user kod, **sy** kernel, **ni** nice'li, **id** bo'sh, **wa** IO kutish, **hi/si** interrupt, **st** steal (VM).
- Yuqoridagi misol: `wa 45` — disk bottleneck.
- **VIRT** — ajratilgan virtual xotira (Go/Java'da katta bo'lishi normal). **RES** — fizik RAM'dagi qism (asosiy metrika). **SHR** — shared lib/mmap.
- Kalitlar: `1` har core, `P`/`M` sort, `H` thread'lar, `c` to'liq buyruq, `k` kill, `top -p PID`, `top -b -n1` (skript uchun).

| r | CPU kutayotgan jarayonlar | r > core soni = CPU saturation |
| b | D-state (IO) | doimiy > 0 = IO muammo |
| si/so | swap in/out | > 0 doimiy = RAM yetmaydi |
| bi/bo | block in/out | disk trafik |
| cs | context switch | juda yuqori = lock contention / ko'p thread |
| wa / st | IO wait / steal | |

**iostat -xz 1** (birinchi chiqish = boot'dan beri o'rtacha, e'tiborga olma)
| Ustun | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| r/s, w/s | IOPS |
| rkB/s, wkB/s | throughput |
| r_await, w_await | ms, so'rov kutish+xizmat (SSD'da >10ms shubhali) |
| aqu-sz | navbat uzunligi |
| %util | band vaqt % (NVMe/RAID'da 100% != to'yingan) |

31320.a:

- systemd servis: `LimitNOFILE=65536` (limits.conf systemd servislariga **ta'sir qilmaydi**!)
- login sessiya: `/etc/security/limits.conf`: `app soft nofile 65536`
- shell: `ulimit -n` (`-Sn`/`-Hn`)
- tizim: `fs.file-max`, `fs.nr_open`
- Docker: `--ulimit nofile=65536:65536`


Tahlil:
- RSS trendi (Prometheus `process_resident_memory_bytes`): arra (GC) normal, monoton o'sish — leak.
- Go: `go tool pprof http://host/debug/pprof/heap`, `-diff_base`; goroutine leak: `/debug/pprof/goroutine`. `GOMEMLIMIT` = limitning ~90%.
- Java: heap dump, `-XX:MaxRAMPercentage`.
- Kritik jarayonni himoya: `OOMScoreAdjust=-500` (sshd uchun).

31323.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `iostat -xz 1` bilan disk to'yinganligini (yuqori `await`, `%util`, navbat) aniqlaysiz, `iotop -oPa` / `pidstat -d 1` bilan aybdor jarayonni topasiz, `D` holatidagi jarayonlar va PSI (`/proc/pressure/io`) bilan tasdiqlaysiz.

**Qadamlar:**
```
Simptom: latency o'sdi, load yuqori, CPU bo'sh
   v
iostat -xz 1    -> qaysi disk? await ms, aqu-sz, %util
   v
pidstat -d 1 / iotop -oPa -> qaysi PID ko'p yozyapti/o'qiyapti
   v
nima uchun? -> strace -e trace=write,fsync -p PID / log hajmi / backup
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
iostat -xz 1
# Device  r/s  w/s  r_await w_await aqu-sz %util
# nvme0n1 20  4800   0.5    45.0    210    99.8   <- yozuv to'yingan
sudo iotop -oPa
pidstat -d 1
ps -eo stat,pid,wchan:30,cmd | awk '$1 ~ /D/'
cat /proc/pressure/io
vmstat 1        # si/so > 0 -> bu RAM muammosi (swap), disk emas
```

**Sabab va yechim:**
| Sabab | Yechim |
|---|---|
| swap (si/so) | RAM/limit masalasi |
| har yozuvda fsync / verbose log | buferlash, async log, log level |
| backup/rsync | `ionice -c3`, `rsync --bwlimit` |
| cloud IOPS kvotasi | gp3 + provisioned IOPS |
| `atime` yangilanishi | `noatime` mount |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- NVMe'da `%util` 100% to'yinganlikni anglatmaydi — `await` va `aqu-sz` ga qarang.
- `iotop` eski kernelda `CONFIG_TASK_IO_ACCOUNTING` talab qiladi.
- Page cache yozuvlari kernel flush thread'iga (`kworker`, `jbd2`) tegishli ko'rinadi — haqiqiy egasi boshqa.

**Senior nuqta:** Cloud'da birinchi navbatda volume metrikalarini (IOPS/throughput limit, burst balance) tekshiring — ko'p "disk sekin" incidentlar kvota tugashi.

31324.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Bu kernel'ning **hung task detector** xabari: jarayon 120 soniyadan ko'proq `D` (uninterruptible) holatda qolgan. Sabab deyarli doim I/O: o'layotgan disk, sekin cloud volume, javob bermayotgan NFS yoki juda ko'p dirty data flush.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
khungtaskd har 120s tekshiradi
  D holatdagi task 120s dan beri ishlamagan?
     v
  dmesg: "INFO: task xyz:1234 blocked for more than 120 seconds."
         + Call Trace (kernel stack)
  kernel.hung_task_panic=1 bo'lsa -> panic
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
dmesg -T | grep -A20 "blocked for more than"
ps -eo stat,pid,wchan:32,cmd | grep "^D"
sudo cat /proc/<PID>/stack
mount | grep nfs ; nfsstat -c
iostat -xz 1
sudo smartctl -a /dev/sda | grep -i -E 'realloc|pending|error'
grep -E 'Dirty|Writeback' /proc/meminfo
```
**Stack'ni o'qish:**
| Stack'da | Sabab |
|---|---|
| `nfs_*`, `rpc_*` | NFS server yo'q / tarmoq |
| `jbd2`, `ext4_*` | journal yozuvi sekin, disk |
| `blk_mq_*`, `io_schedule` | blok qurilma javob bermayapti |
| `balance_dirty_pages` | dirty limit, flush bo'roni |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- D-state jarayonni o'ldirib bo'lmaydi — I/O qaytishi yoki reboot kerak.
- NFS `soft` mount'ga o'tish osilishni kamaytiradi, lekin yozuvlarda jim **data corruption** xavfi bor.
- `umount -f -l` faqat ilovani "ozod" qiladi, ma'lumot muammosini emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Load average osmonga chiqadi, CPU bo'sh — klassik manzara. Bu xabarni log alertiga ulang va disk SMART/cloud volume holatini monitoring qiling — ko'pincha bu disk o'limining birinchi belgisi.

31325.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `free` ustuni kichik bo'lishi normal — Linux bo'sh RAM'ni page cache sifatida ishlatadi ("unused RAM is wasted RAM"). Haqiqiy ko'rsatkich — **`available`** (`MemAvailable`). Bosimni swap faolligi va PSI bilan o'lchang.

**O'qish:**
```
              total   used   free  shared  buff/cache  available
Mem:           15Gi   4.1Gi  300Mi  200Mi     11Gi        10Gi
Swap:          2Gi    0B     2Gi
```
- `used` 4.1Gi — ilovalar.
- `free` 300Mi — qo'rqmang.
- `buff/cache` 11Gi — fayl kesh, bosim bo'lsa bo'shatiladi.
- `available` 10Gi — ilovalar swap'siz olishi mumkin.

**`/proc/meminfo` muhim maydonlari:**
| Maydon | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| MemAvailable | asosiy ko'rsatkich |
| Dirty / Writeback | diskka yozilishi kutilayotgan |
| Slab / SReclaimable | dentry/inode kesh (bo'shatiladi) |
| SUnreclaim | kernel, bo'shatilmaydi (leak belgisi) |
| Shmem | tmpfs, /dev/shm — kesh emas! |
| AnonPages | ilova heap'lari |
| Committed_AS | va'da qilingan xotira |

**Amalda:**
```bash
free -h
grep -E 'MemAvailable|Dirty|Slab|SUnreclaim|Shmem:|AnonPages|Committed_AS' /proc/meminfo
cat /proc/pressure/memory    # some avg10=0.00 -> bosim yo'q
slabtop -o | head            # qaysi kernel kesh katta
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `drop_caches` — prod'da tuzatish emas, faqat benchmark uchun; keyin disk I/O sakraydi.
- Katta `SUnreclaim` doimiy o'ssa — kernel/drayver leak.
- Konteyner ichida `free` host'ni ko'rsatadi — `memory.current`/`memory.stat` o'qing.

**Senior nuqta:** cgroup v2'da konteyner xotirasiga page cache ham kiradi — `memory.current` limitga yaqin ko'rinadi, lekin bu reclaim qilinadi. Haqiqiy signal: `memory.events` dagi `oom_kill` va `memory.pressure`.

1. **Detect/triage:** ta'sir kimga, qancha (SLO)? Severity.
2. **Rollar:** incident commander, ops, comms. Bitta kanal, timestamp bilan yozuv.
3. **Mitigate:** "oxirgi o'zgarish nima edi?" — deploy/config/infra. Rollback eng tez yo'l. Restart qilishdan oldin: `top -b -n1`, `ss -s`, goroutine/heap dump, `journalctl` export, core dump.
4. **Verify:** metrikalar normalga qaytdimi.

Interview'da kuchli javob: "Avval qon to'xtataman, dalilni yo'qotmasdan, keyin tahlil qilaman va takrorlanmasligi uchun alert + avtomatlashtirish qo'shaman."

31327.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `ip` (iproute2 paketi) — zamonaviy tarmoq tool'i: `ip a` (manzillar), `ip link` (interfeyslar), `ip r` (marshrutlar), `ip neigh` (ARP). `ifconfig`, `route`, `netstat`, `arp` — eski **net-tools** paketidan, deprecated va ko'p yangi distributivlarda default o'rnatilmagan.

**Amalda:**
```bash
ip -br a                       # qisqa: eth0 UP 10.0.0.5/24
ip -4 a show eth0
ip link set eth0 up
sudo ip addr add 10.0.0.6/24 dev eth0     # vaqtinchalik (reboot'da yo'qoladi)
ip r                           # default via 10.0.0.1 dev eth0
ip route get 8.8.8.8           # shu manzilga qaysi interfeys/gateway/src IP
ip neigh                       # 10.0.0.1 lladdr aa:bb:.. REACHABLE
ip -s link show eth0           # RX/TX errors, dropped
ss -tulpn                      # netstat -tulpn o'rniga
```

| Eski (net-tools) | Yangi (iproute2) |
|---|---|
| `ifconfig` | `ip a`, `ip link` |
| `route -n` | `ip r` |
| `netstat -tulpn` | `ss -tulpn` |
| `arp -n` | `ip neigh` |

**Doimiy sozlama:** `ip` bilan qilingan o'zgarish reboot'da yo'qoladi.
```yaml
# Ubuntu: /etc/netplan/50-cloud.yaml
network:
  version: 2
  ethernets:
    eth0:
      addresses: [10.0.0.5/24]
      routes: [{to: default, via: 10.0.0.1}]
```
```bash
sudo netplan try        # 120s ichida tasdiqlamasangiz qaytaradi
nmcli con show          # RHEL: NetworkManager
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Masofadan `ip link set eth0 down` yoki noto'g'ri route — SSH uziladi; `netplan try` xavfsiz.
- `ifconfig` bitta interfeysdagi ikkinchi IP'ni ko'rsatmasligi mumkin.
- `ip -s link` dagi `dropped` o'sishi — NIC yoki ring buffer muammosi.

**Senior nuqta:** `ip route get <IP>` — "bu paket qayerga ketadi?" degan savolga eng tez javob, ko'p NIC'li yoki VPN'li serverda routing xatolarini darhol ko'rsatadi.

```
ss -tan state time-wait | wc -l
```

```
curl -v telnet://host:6379
timeout 3 bash -c '</dev/tcp/host/443' && echo open
```

```
curl -v https://api.x.com/health                  # TLS handshake, header'lar
curl -I https://x.com                              # HEAD
curl -sS -f -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" URL   # healthcheck skript
```

`-w` timing — qaysi bosqich sekinligini (DNS/TCP/TLS/server) bir buyruqda ko'rsatadi.

31330.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `dig` — batafsil DNS so'rovi (javob, TTL, flag'lar, qaysi server); `nslookup` — eski, soddaroq. `/etc/hosts` — lokal statik nomlar (DNS'dan oldin tekshiriladi); `/etc/resolv.conf` — qaysi DNS serverdan va qanday qoidalar bilan so'rash.

**Amalda:**
```bash
dig +short api.x.com
dig api.x.com A +noall +answer        # api.x.com. 300 IN A 1.2.3.4  (300 = TTL)
dig @1.1.1.1 api.x.com                # boshqa resolver
dig +trace api.x.com                  # root -> .com -> authoritative
dig -x 10.0.0.5                       # reverse (PTR)
dig api.x.com MX / TXT / CNAME
getent hosts api.x.com                # ilova ko'radigan natija
resolvectl status ; resolvectl query api.x.com
```
`/etc/resolv.conf`:
```
nameserver 127.0.0.53
search corp.local
options ndots:5 timeout:2 attempts:2
```

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
getaddrinfo -> nsswitch (hosts: files dns)
  files -> /etc/hosts
  dns   -> resolv.conf -> 127.0.0.53 (systemd-resolved, kesh) -> upstream
dig -> to'g'ridan-to'g'ri DNS (hosts va nsswitch'ni chetlab)
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `dig` va ilova natijasi farqli — normal: `dig` `/etc/hosts` ni o'qimaydi; ilova kabi tekshirish uchun `getent`.
- K8s `ndots:5`: `google.com` ga 5 ta keraksiz so'rov (search domain'lar) — tashqi FQDN'ga oxirgi `.` qo'shing yoki `dnsConfig` bilan `ndots:2`.
- Kesh: systemd-resolved, nscd, Java (`networkaddress.cache.ttl`) — TTL'dan keyin ham eski IP.

**Senior nuqta:** DNS migratsiyasidan bir kun oldin TTL'ni 60s ga tushiring, keyin almashtiring. `dig +trace` delegation xatolarini (NS yozuvlari, glue) topishning eng tez yo'li.

31331.a:
```
tcpdump -i any -nn port 5432                    # -nn DNS/port nomini hal qilmaydi
tcpdump -i eth0 -nn host 10.0.0.7 and port 80
tcpdump -i any -nn 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn|tcp-rst) != 0'   # SYN/RST
tcpdump -i any -nn -A -s0 port 8080             # HTTP payload ASCII
tcpdump -i any -w /tmp/cap.pcap -c 10000 port 443   # Wireshark uchun
```

Prod: `-c`/vaqt bilan cheklagin, disk to'lmasin; payload'da PII/token bo'lishi mumkin — pcap faylni ehtiyot saqla.

- Masofadan qoida o'zgartirishda: `at now + 5 min` bilan avtomatik rollback rejasi.

31333.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Pastdan yuqoriga qatlamma-qatlam: servis ishlaydimi -> qaysi manzilda tinglaydi (`127.0.0.1` mi `0.0.0.0` mi) -> lokal `curl` -> host firewall -> paket umuman kelyaptimi (`tcpdump`) -> cloud SG/NACL/LB -> client tomondagi DNS va route.

**Qadamlar:**
```
[client] -> DNS -> internet -> [cloud SG/NACL] -> [LB] -> [host firewall] -> [ilova bind]
                                                                   ^
                    tcpdump shu nuqtada: paket keldimi?
   keldi, javob yo'q -> host firewall / ilova / rp_filter
   kelmadi           -> SG, NACL, LB, route, DNS
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
systemctl status app
sudo ss -tlnp | grep 8080
# LISTEN 127.0.0.1:8080  <- faqat lokal! tashqaridan ko'rinmaydi
curl -v localhost:8080/health
curl -v http://$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}'):8080/health
sudo ufw status ; sudo firewall-cmd --list-all ; sudo nft list ruleset
sudo tcpdump -i any -nn port 8080
# client tomonda:
dig app.x.com ; nc -zv app.x.com 8080 ; mtr app.x.com
```
Docker: `docker ps` da `0.0.0.0:8080->8080/tcp` bormi; konteyner ichida ilova `0.0.0.0` da tinglaydimi (`localhost` emas).
K8s: `kubectl get endpoints svc` bo'shmi (selector/readiness), NetworkPolicy, Ingress qoidasi.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Ilova `127.0.0.1` ga bind — eng ko'p uchraydigan sabab.
- Cloud SG ochiq, lekin OS firewall (ufw/firewalld) yopiq — yoki aksincha.
- `ping` ishlamasligidan xulosa chiqarish — ICMP bloklangan bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** `tcpdump` — hakam: paket kelgan-kelmaganini bilish muammoni ikkiga bo'ladi (binary search). Xavfsizlik tomondan: debug paytida firewall'ni "vaqtincha" butunlay o'chirmang — faqat aniq port/manba uchun qoida qo'shing.

31334.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `ping` (kichik ICMP paket) o'tishi kichik paketlar o'tishini bildiradi, katta paketlar haqida hech narsa demaydi. Klassik sabab — **MTU / PMTU black hole**: yo'lda MTU kichikroq (VPN, VXLAN), lekin "fragmentation needed" ICMP xabari bloklangan, katta paketlar jim yo'qoladi. `mtr` — har hop'dagi yo'qotish va latency, `traceroute -T` — TCP bilan marshrut.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
Host MTU 1500 --> router --> VPN tunnel MTU 1400 --> server
 1500 baytli paket (DF bit) -> router: "sig'maydi" -> ICMP frag-needed
 ICMP firewall'da bloklangan -> host bilmaydi -> qayta yuboradi -> yo'qoladi
Simptom: SSH ulanadi, `ls` ishlaydi, `cat big.log` yoki TLS handshake osiladi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
mtr -rwzc 100 host                 # Loss% va Avg har hop'da
traceroute -T -p 443 host          # ICMP bloklangan joyda TCP
ping -M do -s 1472 host            # 1472 + 28 = 1500, DF bilan
ping -M do -s 1372 host            # kichraytirib chegara topiladi
ip link show eth0 | grep mtu
tracepath host                     # PMTU'ni avtomatik topadi
```
**Yechim:**
```bash
sudo ip link set eth0 mtu 1400
sudo iptables -t mangle -A FORWARD -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `mtr` da oraliq hop'da loss, oxirgi hop'da yo'q — router ICMP'ni rate-limit qilyapti, muammo emas.
- ICMP'ni butunlay bloklash ("xavfsizlik uchun") — PMTUD'ni buzadi; `fragmentation-needed` (type 3 code 4) ruxsat bo'lishi kerak.
- K8s overlay (VXLAN 50 bayt overhead) — pod MTU host MTU'dan kichik bo'lishi kerak.

**Senior nuqta:** Firewall siyosatida ICMP'ni "hammasi yoki hech narsa" emas, kerakli turlarini (echo, frag-needed, time-exceeded) ruxsat bering. Cloud'da jumbo frame (9001) va VPN gateway (1500 dan kam) aralashganda MTU muammolari ayniqsa ko'p.

31336.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Signal — kernel jarayonga yuboradigan asinxron xabar. **SIGTERM (15)** — "iltimos, tugat" (ushlanadi), **SIGKILL (9)** — majburiy o'lim (ushlanmaydi), **SIGHUP (1)** — terminal uzildi / config qayta o'qish, **SIGINT (2)** — Ctrl+C, **SIGSTOP (19)** — muzlatish (ushlanmaydi, `SIGCONT` bilan davom).

**Nega muhim:** To'g'ri signal tanlash = ma'lumot yo'qotmaslik. SIGKILL cleanup'ga imkon bermaydi: lock fayl, temp fayl, yozilmagan log, yarim tranzaksiya qoladi.

| Signal | Raqam | Ushlanadimi | Odatiy ishlatilish |
|---|---|---|---|
| SIGHUP | 1 | Ha | nginx/sshd config reload |
| SIGINT | 2 | Ha | Ctrl+C |
| SIGKILL | 9 | Yo'q | oxirgi chora |
| SIGTERM | 15 | Ha | graceful stop (default) |
| SIGSTOP | 19 | Yo'q | pauza |

**Amalda:**
```bash
kill 1234                 # SIGTERM
kill -HUP $(pidof nginx)  # reload
pgrep -a -f "worker.py"   # AVVAL kimga tegishini ko'r
pkill -f "worker.py"      # buyruq qatori bo'yicha
killall nginx             # nom bo'yicha
kill -0 1234 && echo tirik  # signal yubormaydi, mavjudlikni tekshiradi
kill -l                   # ro'yxat
```
Exit kodi `128+N`: `137` = SIGKILL (ko'pincha OOM killer), `143` = SIGTERM, `130` = Ctrl+C.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `pkill -f java` kutilmagan jarayonlarni ham o'ldiradi — doim avval `pgrep -a`.
- Solaris'da `killall` hamma jarayonni o'ldiradi — boshqa Unix'da ehtiyot bo'ling.
- `D` holatidagi (disk kutayotgan) jarayonga SIGKILL ham ta'sir qilmaydi.

**Senior nuqta:** Avtomatlashtirishda pattern: SIGTERM -> timeout (masalan 30s) -> SIGKILL. systemd (`TimeoutStopSec`) va Kubernetes (`terminationGracePeriodSeconds`) aynan shunday qiladi.

31337.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `&` — buyruqni fonda ishga tushiradi; **Ctrl+Z** — to'xtatadi (SIGTSTP); `bg`/`fg` — fonda/oldinda davom ettiradi; `jobs` — ro'yxat; `nohup` — SIGHUP'dan himoya; `disown` — ishlab turgan job'ni shell'dan ajratadi; `tmux`/`screen` — serverda yashaydigan terminal.

**Muammo:** SSH'da 2 soatlik migration boshladingiz, ulanish uzildi — jarayon o'ldi, DB yarim holatda. Bundan himoyalanish yo'llari shular.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
cmd           -> foreground: terminal band
cmd &         -> background job [1]
Ctrl+Z        -> Stopped (T)  --bg--> fonda davom
                              --fg--> oldinga qaytadi
disown -h %1  -> shell exit'da SIGHUP yubormaydi
tmux          -> sessiya serverda, siz detach/attach qilasiz
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
long_task &                 # [1] 12345
jobs -l                     # [1]+ 12345 Running
fg %1 ; # Ctrl+Z ; 
bg %1
nohup ./migrate.sh > migrate.log 2>&1 &
disown -h %1                # unutgan bo'lsangiz — keyin ham qutqarsa bo'ladi
setsid ./job.sh             # yangi sessiya
systemd-run --unit=reindex ./reindex.sh   # journald log, systemctl status
tmux new -s deploy ; # Ctrl+b d ; 
tmux attach -t deploy
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Fondagi job stdin'dan o'qimoqchi bo'lsa `SIGTTIN` bilan to'xtab qoladi — `< /dev/null` bering.
- `disown` stdout'ni yopmaydi — terminal yopilgach yozish xatoga olib kelishi mumkin; log faylga yo'naltiring.
- `jobs` faqat joriy shell job'larini ko'rsatadi, boshqa sessiyanikini emas.

**Senior nuqta:** Prod qoida: kritik uzoq ishni hech qachon oddiy SSH terminalda boshlama — `tmux` yoki `systemd-run` (log va status bilan). Bu kichik odat ko'p incident'larning oldini oladi.

31338.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `nice`/`renice` — CPU prioritetini (vaznini) o'zgartiradi; `ionice` — disk I/O prioritetini; `taskset` — jarayonni muayyan CPU core'larga bog'laydi (affinity); `chrt` — real-time siyosat.

**Muammo:** Kechasi backup ishga tushganda API latency 3x oshadi. Backup'ni "faqat bo'sh resursdan foydalan" rejimiga o'tkazish kerak.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
CPU:  nice -20 ...... 0 ...... 19     (ko'p ulush -> kam ulush)
I/O:  ionice -c1 (realtime) | -c2 -n0..7 (best-effort) | -c3 (idle)
Core: taskset -c 0-3  -> faqat 0,1,2,3 core'larda ishlaydi
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
nice -n 19 ionice -c3 tar czf /backup/data.tgz /data   # backup klassikasi
renice -n 10 -p 1234
ionice -c2 -n7 -p 1234
taskset -cp 0-3 1234           # mavjud jarayonni bog'lash
taskset -c 4-7 ./latency_app   # izolyatsiya qilingan core'larda
chrt -p 1234                   # joriy siyosat: SCHED_OTHER
ps -eo pid,ni,psr,cmd | head   # PSR = hozir qaysi core'da
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- nice faqat CPU *raqobat* bo'lganda ta'sir qiladi.
- `ionice` faqat BFQ/CFQ scheduler'da ishlaydi; NVMe'da default `none`/`mq-deadline` — `ionice -c3` deyarli ta'sirsiz (`cat /sys/block/nvme0n1/queue/scheduler`).
- `taskset` NUMA'ni hisobga olmaydi — `numactl --cpunodebind --membind` kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

**Senior nuqta:** Servis/konteyner uchun to'g'ri vosita cgroup: `CPUWeight`, `CPUQuota`, `IOWeight`, `IOReadBandwidthMax` (systemd) yoki K8s requests/limits. Latency-kritik ilova uchun `isolcpus`/CPU Manager `static` policy bilan alohida core.

31340.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `chmod` — ruxsatlarni o'zgartiradi (octal `640` yoki symbolic `u+x,g-w`); `chown user:group` — egasi va guruhini; `chgrp` — faqat guruhni. `-R` — rekursiv. Octal: r=4, w=2, x=1, uchta raqam — **user, group, others**.

**Muammo:** Ilova `Permission denied` bilan config'ni o'qiy olmaydi. "Tez yechim" `chmod -R 777` — har kim o'qiy va yoza oladi, bu xavfsizlik teshigi.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
-rw-r----- = 640
  rw-  (6 = 4+2)  user (egasi)
  r--  (4)        group
  ---  (0)        others
katalogda: r = ro'yxat, w = fayl yaratish/o'chirish, x = ichiga kirish
```

**Amalda:**
```bash
chmod 640 app.conf                 # rw- r-- ---
chmod 755 deploy.sh                # rwx r-x r-x
chmod u+x,g-w script.sh            # symbolic
chmod -R u=rwX,g=rX,o= /srv/app    # X (katta): faqat katalog va allaqachon bajariladiganlarga x
chown app:app /var/lib/app
chown -R www-data: /var/www        # ":" — user'ning asosiy guruhi
chgrp devs shared.txt
stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' app.conf     # 640 app:app app.conf

# Fayl va katalogga alohida
find /srv -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +
find /srv -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +
```

| Octal | Ma'nosi | Tipik |
|---|---|---|
| 600 | faqat egasi o'qish/yozish | SSH kalit, sir |
| 644 | hamma o'qiydi | oddiy fayl |
| 640 | guruh o'qiydi | config |
| 755 | hamma bajaradi | binary, katalog |
| 700 | faqat egasi | `~/.ssh` |

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `chmod -R 777` — muammoni yashiradi va teshik ochadi; to'g'ri egalik/guruh ber.
- `chmod -R 644 dir` — kataloglardan `x` olinadi, ichiga kirib bo'lmaydi; `X` yoki `find -type`.
- `chown -R user /` kabi xato — tizimni buzadi; `--preserve-root` default, lekin `/*` himoyalanmagan.
- `chown` faqat root (oddiy user faylni boshqaga bera olmaydi).

**Senior nuqta:** Least privilege: servis o'z user'i bilan, config `640 root:app`, sirlar `600`. Ruxsatlarni qo'lda emas, paket/IaC (Ansible `file` moduli, `install -m`) orqali o'rnat — drift bo'lmasin.

31341.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Eng kerakli `grep` flaglari: `-r` (rekursiv), `-n` (qator raqami), `-i` (katta-kichik harfsiz), `-v` (teskari), `-c` (son), `-l` (faqat fayl nomlari), `-w` (butun so'z), `-E` (kengaytirilgan regex), `-F` (oddiy matn), `-o` (faqat moslik), `-A/-B/-C` (kontekst), `--include` (fayl filtri).

**Muammo:** Incident: "panic" qayerda va undan oldin nima bo'ldi? Config'da qaysi faylda parol bor? To'g'ri flag bilan javob bir buyruqda.

**Amalda:**
```bash
grep -rn "ERROR" /var/log/app/              # rekursiv + qator raqami
grep -i "timeout" app.log                   # Timeout, TIMEOUT ...
grep -v "^#" nginx.conf | grep -v "^$"      # izoh va bo'sh qatorlarsiz
grep -Ev '^\s*(#|$)' nginx.conf             # xuddi shu, bitta grep
grep -c " 500 " access.log                  # mos qatorlar soni
grep -rl "password" /etc 2>/dev/null        # faqat fayl nomlari
grep -w "id" file                           # "id", lekin "uid" emas
grep -E "ERROR|FATAL" app.log               # yoki
grep -F "a.b[1]" file                       # regex emas, aynan matn
grep -oE '([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
grep -A5 -B2 "panic" app.log                # 2 qator oldin, 5 keyin
grep -r --include="*.yaml" "image:" .       # faqat yaml fayllarda
grep -q "ready" status && echo ok           # jim, faqat exit kod
zgrep "ERROR" app.log.2.gz                  # siqilgan log
```
Exit kod: 0 — topildi, 1 — topilmadi, 2 — xato.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Naqshni qo'shtirnoqsiz yozish — shell glob qiladi.
- `grep -r` symlink'larga ergashmaydi (`-R` ergashadi).
- `set -e` skriptda topilmaslik (1) skriptni to'xtatadi — `|| true`.
- `grep "a.b"` — `.` istalgan belgi; aynan uchun `-F`.

**Senior nuqta:** Katta kod bazasi yoki ko'p fayl uchun `rg` (ripgrep) ancha tez va `.gitignore`ni hisobga oladi; serverlararo log qidiruvi esa markaziy log tizimida bo'lishi kerak.

31342.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `tail -n N` — oxirgi qatorlar; `tail -f` / **`-F`** — real vaqtda kuzatish (`-F` logrotate'dan keyin ham ishlaydi); `less +F` — kuzatish + to'xtatib qidirish; `head` — boshi; `wc -l` — qatorlar soni; `sed -n 'a,bp'` — oraliq.

**Muammo:** 20 GB log faylni `cat` yoki `vim` bilan ochish — terminal/xotira qotadi. Kerakli qismni tez ko'rish usullari kerak.

**Amalda:**
```bash
tail -n 200 app.log
tail -F app.log | grep --line-buffered ERROR    # real vaqt filtri
less +F app.log
#   Ctrl+C  -> kuzatishni to'xtat, /text qidir, n/N
#   F       -> yana kuzat;  G oxir, g bosh;  q chiqish
less -S wide.log                    # uzun qatorlarni o'ramaslik
head -n 20 file
wc -l access.log
sed -n '1000,1100p' big.log         # oraliq qatorlar
awk '$9 >= 500' access.log | wc -l  # 5xx soni (nginx combined)
tail -n +2 data.csv                 # 2-qatordan boshlab (sarlavhasiz)
journalctl -u app -f                # systemd servis logi
kubectl logs -f deploy/app --tail=100
```

**`-f` vs `-F`:**
```
logrotate: app.log -> app.log.1 (ko'chirildi), yangi app.log yaratildi
tail -f: eski fayl deskriptorida qoladi -> yangi yozuvlar ko'rinmaydi
tail -F: nom bo'yicha qayta ochadi -> yangi fayldan davom etadi
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `tail -f | grep | awk` — grep bufer qiladi, natija kechikadi; `--line-buffered`.
- `less` katta faylda `G` bosilsa barcha qatorlarni sanaydi — `less -n` tezroq.
- `cat huge.log` terminalni to'ldiradi; binary log — terminal buziladi (`reset`).

**Senior nuqta:** Bitta serverda `tail -F` debug uchun yaxshi; ko'p replika va konteynerlarda — `kubectl logs -l app=x`, `stern` yoki markaziy log (Loki) — bitta pod logi umumiy rasmni bermaydi.

31343.a:
```
# /etc/logrotate.d/app
/var/log/app/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 14
    maxsize 500M
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 0640 app app
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        systemctl kill -s HUP app.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    endscript
}
```
```
logrotate -d /etc/logrotate.d/app     # dry-run
logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/app     # majburiy
```
- `create` + postrotate HUP: toza, ilova faylni qayta ochishi kerak. HUP'siz ilova o'chirilgan faylga yozishda davom etadi = "disk to'la, du kam".
- `copytruncate`: ilova o'zgartirilmaydi, lekin copy va truncate orasida qatorlar yo'qoladi.
- Zamonaviy: ilova stdout'ga yozadi -> journald/konteyner runtime aylantiradi.

31346.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `cp -a` — metadata (ruxsat, egasi, vaqt, symlink) bilan nusxa; `mv` — ko'chirish/qayta nomlash (bitta FS ichida atomik); `rm -rf` — qaytarib bo'lmaydigan o'chirish, o'zgaruvchilar bilan ayniqsa xavfli; `ln -s` — symlink; `mkdir -p` — oraliq kataloglar bilan; `install` — nusxa + ruxsat + egalikni bitta buyruqda.

**Muammo:** Config o'zgartirishdan oldin zaxira kerak; release'ni atomik almashtirish kerak; skriptdagi `rm -rf $DIR/` o'zgaruvchi bo'sh bo'lganda tizimni o'chirmasligi kerak.

**Amalda:**
```bash
cp -a /etc/nginx /etc/nginx.bak.$(date +%F)   # o'zgartirishdan oldin
cp -i src dst; mv -i src dst                  # ustiga yozishdan oldin so'raydi
mv -n src dst                                 # mavjud bo'lsa yozmaydi
mkdir -p /opt/app/{bin,conf,logs}
ln -sfn /opt/app/releases/v42 /opt/app/current   # release almashtirish
readlink -f /opt/app/current
install -m 0755 -o root -g root app /usr/local/bin/app
install -d -m 0750 -o app -g app /var/lib/app     # katalog yaratish
```

**Atomik release almashtirish:**
```bash
ln -s /opt/app/releases/v43 /opt/app/current.tmp
mv -T /opt/app/current.tmp /opt/app/current    # rename() — haqiqatan atomik
```
(`ln -sfn` ichida unlink + symlink — qisqa oraliq bor.)

**rm xavfsizligi:**
```bash
set -u
rm -rf "${DIR:?DIR bo'sh}"/build     # bo'sh bo'lsa skript to'xtaydi
ls -d "$DIR"/build                    # avval nima o'chishini ko'r
mv old-data /srv/trash/$(date +%F)/   # prod'da: avval ko'chir, keyin o'chir
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- `mv` boshqa FS'ga — aslida copy + delete, atomik emas.
- `cp -r` symlink'larni ergashib nusxalaydi — `-a` saqlaydi.
- `rm -rf dir /` (tasodifiy bo'shliq) — `--preserve-root` faqat `/` ni himoya qiladi.
- Ochiq faylni `rm` qilish disk joyini bo'shatmaydi (jarayon ushlab turadi).

**Senior nuqta:** O'chirish operatsiyalarini "ikki bosqichli" qil: ko'chir/belgila, keyin kechiktirib o'chir. Deploy uchun releases katalogi + symlink — rollback bir buyruq bo'ladi.
